title: refactor: sweep the #4918 `as any` sites in engine.ts's six erasure-pinned methods so the codemod can move them (about 550 lines)
body:
domain:server#6 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzibcN9oHa8kDbTTnL5

Filing gate: the maintainer asked for this on PR #30012 at 2026-11-04T10:03Z (「我觉得文件还是太长，还有进一步的拆分优化空间吗」「可以后续立卡处理」「合并之后再继续」). The facades are merged: engine.ts as 237f5137 (#30012) and protocol.ts as 48914fdc (#29998). Estimates come from the #29986 / #29985 dev reports. ⛔ Not a claim. Triage sets the grade and the lane (devx or server).

Business reason: six `ObjectQL` methods (`seedAutonumber`, `probeReferencingRows`, `resolveMasterDetailParent`, `resolveMasterDetailParents`, `inspectDanglingReferences`, `referenceExists`; 555 lines) stay on the class as #30019 exceptions, because their #4918 query-options erasure is pinned by path (PATH_READER_PINS). Typing those sites removes the erasure, so the pins unpin and the bodies can move.
Reader who acts: `packages/objectql` owner.

## What to do
- Type the erased query options at each site, with no behaviour change. Re-key or retire the PATH_READER_PINS rows. Then re-run the codemod and drop the rows from the #30019 allow-list.
Dedupe: `4918 erasure`, `PATH_READER_PINS`. **New.**
